forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?

Qatar/Pakistan backchannels before June 16 were not publicly confirmed by both parties as a formally convened session with named envoys. The first TIER1-confirmed formally convened session (Burgenstock, June 21-22) occurred after the June 16 horizon.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; electronic document signing = written communication, excluded; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
